## GHCode product requirements

### Product

Provide a reliable GitHub development environment in which desired product intent, observed repository structure and evidence-qualified differences are different projections of one project state.

### Workflow

The user chooses one GitHub repository/ref. Specification reads the project-owned canonical PRD; Repository inspects the working tree; Delta derives verified discrepancies and prepares issue drafts; Overview summarizes. Documents remain editable via existing Monaco tabs. The activity rail activates native Dockview perspective tabs in the same main tab strip as Monaco, Browser and other documents. Every perspective is a real tab, with no second canvas and no nested tab bar.

### Verification

Cross-view switching, sidebar collapse, z-index interactions, source editing, browser layout, production Pages Actions deployment and test discovery need behavior-driven tests. No fake success states or unverified live integration claims.
